fato_historico: 1973: Watergate scandal: "Saturday Night Massacre": United States President Richard Nixon fires U.S. Attorney General Elliot Richardson and Deputy Attorney General William Ruckelshaus after they refuse to fire special prosecutor Archibald Cox, who is finally fired by Solicitor General Robert Bork.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel a push toward integrity and firm boundaries. Much like shifting tides of historical transparency, it is a good time to uphold your values firmly. Consider how your unwavering commitment to truth can clear away past turbulence, allowing fresh, hopeful opportunities to blossom like a hidden four-leaf clover in your garden.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in standing by your principles even when the storm is loud.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of independence and the start of new cycles.
conselho: Trust your judgment and remain steadfast in your pursuit of what is right.
